create_LARS_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer instance with custom learning rate, beta, and weight decay parameters
create_LAMB_optimizer: create a LAMB optimizer instance with custom beta1, beta2, eps, and weight decay parameters
run_LARS_step: run a single LARS optimization step on model parameters with optional closure for loss
run_LAMB_step: run a single LAMB optimization step using Adam-style momentum and trust ratio scaling
review_LAMB_get_update: review the LAMB get_update method that computes bias-corrected Adam updates with weight decay
